Guide

AI meeting notes that stick to what was said

Verbi is an AI meeting notes app for iPhone and Android: record the meeting on your phone, and Verbi gives you the full transcript and a summary with the decisions and to-dos, where owners and due dates appear only when someone said them. It’s free to start, with 60 minutes of transcription a month, and nothing joins your call.

Free to download, with 60 minutes of transcription every month.

Last updated: October 19, 2026

How do I get AI meeting notes from a recording?

  1. Let everyone know you’re recording. Then tap Record & Transcribe, or Live Transcription if you want to follow along.
  2. Put the phone in the middle of the table. For an online meeting, use your speaker in a quiet room and keep the phone close to it.
  3. With Pro, Verbi tells the voices apart. If you know how many people will speak, set the Number of Speakers.
  4. Stop the recording when the meeting ends. If you leave the app, Verbi sends a notification when the transcript is ready (on Android, and on iPhone with iOS 26 or later; on older iOS versions, transcription continues when you reopen Verbi).
  5. With Pro, pick the template that fits (General Meeting, 1:1 Meeting, Daily Meeting, Weekly Meeting, Action Items or Email Draft) and tap Generate Summary. On the free plan, your first transcript gets one summary automatically, with your default template.
  6. With Pro, name the speakers, ask the transcript follow-up questions, and share the notes or export them as PDF. On the free plan, copy the text.

What’s in the meeting notes?

  • The full transcript with the speakers told apart, so you can see who said what (speaker detection is part of Pro).
  • Decisions written as decisions, with suggestions kept apart from them.
  • A to-do list with owners and due dates when someone stated them. If nobody said who or when, Verbi doesn’t make it up.
  • No filler: sections nobody talked about are left out.
  • An email draft for the people who weren’t there.
  • With Pro, answers to questions like “What did we decide about the budget?”, drawn from what was said.
  • Meeting reminders: Verbi reads your calendar and reminds you to record when a meeting starts.

How do I get better meeting notes?

  • Say decisions and owners out loud: “Let’s go with option B. Sam, can you send the draft by Friday?” Verbi writes down an owner and a date only when someone says them, so saying them is what puts them in your notes.
  • Ask people to say their name the first time they speak. Naming the voices afterwards gets easy.
  • Add client names, product names and acronyms to Custom Vocabulary before the meeting.
  • Turn on meeting reminders so you don’t forget to press record.

Is there a free plan for meeting notes?

Yes. The free plan gives you 60 minutes of transcription a month, recordings kept for 15 days, live transcription (basic on iPhone) and one automatic AI summary, enough to try Verbi on a real meeting.

Verbi Pro adds a summary to every transcript, unlimited transcription, speaker detection, translation, chat with the transcript, sharing and export, high-quality live transcription on iPhone and unlimited history. Recordings and transcripts are stored on your phone; to transcribe and summarize, audio and transcript text are sent to our AI providers, as the privacy policy explains.

Frequently asked questions

Does Verbi join video calls as a bot?

No. Verbi records through your phone’s microphone, so nothing joins your call. For an online meeting, keep the phone near your speaker.

Will the to-do list invent owners or deadlines?

No. Owners and due dates appear only when someone stated them in the recording, and suggestions nobody agreed to are kept apart from decisions.

Can Verbi tell the speakers apart?

Yes, with Pro. Verbi separates the voices, and you can give each one a name.
